page_title: FRE 4-0 MAI | Freiburg v Mainz 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Daniel Schlager is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' The ball possession at the moment is 75:25.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' 4 - 0 Matthias Ginter is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 4:0.
90' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
87' Today's match ends for Philipp Treu (Freiburg) who will be replaced by Max Rosenfelder.
86' Freiburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
81' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Noah Atubolu easily deals with the threat.
80' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Johan Manzambi is replaced by Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) replaces Jan-Niklas Beste.
80' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Freiburg due to an offside in the build-up play.
80' The Freiburg players halt their celebrations as referee Daniel Schlager makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
79' Goal - 4:0! Igor Matanovic laid the ball off to Johan Manzambi (Freiburg), who shot from close range into the top right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
77' A thunderous effort from long range by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.

75' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz. What a huge chance for Igor Matanovic (Freiburg). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
73' A substitution has been made. Benedict Hollerbach goes off and Armindo Sieb (Mainz) comes on.
73' Here's the change. Stefan Bell leaves the pitch and Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) comes on as a substitute.
72' Here is a change. Jae-Sung Lee is going off and Bo Henriksen gives the last tactical orders to William Boving (Mainz).
72' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
70' A raking crossfield pass from Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
70' The referee blows his whistle, Mainz are awarded a corner kick.
69' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) replaces Yuito Suzuki.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christian Gunter (Freiburg) is coming onto the pitch as Lukas Kubler cannot continue after picking up an injury.

68' A terrific piece of skill by Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten.
65' Today's referee Daniel Schlager rightly decides to book Stefan Bell (Mainz) for his harsh tackle.
65' Substitution. Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) replaces Philipp Treu.
63' Great teamplay by Freiburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
60' The percentage of ball possession is – 70:30.
58' Freiburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
55' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
54' The game has come to an end for Arnaud Nordin. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lennard Maloney (Mainz).
53' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) will deliver the corner kick.
52' The game is interrupted. Sota Kawasaki (Mainz) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
51' 3 - 0 Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
50' Freiburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
47' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) heads on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
45+1' A player from Freiburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' 13:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

43' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lasse Riess pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
43' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
43' A cross from Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. It will be a corner kick for Freiburg.
41' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Freiburg.
40' The ball is out of play. Freiburg win a corner kick.

39' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Lucas Holer (Freiburg). The ball goes out of play. Freiburg are awarded a corner kick.
35' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 60:40.
33' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a long ball in, but Lasse Riess comfortably gathers the ball.
32' The Freiburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
28' Paul Nebel (Mainz) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
26' 2 - 0 Goal Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg)! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) was put through by Lucas Holer and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the left side of the net. 2:0.

24' A short pass finds Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
22' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Lasse Riess has it covered and makes a comfortable save.

19' That didn't go as planned! Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Lasse Riess, who easily kept it out.
17' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
15' Paul Nebel (Mainz) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' 1 - 0 Goal! Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
12' Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
11' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
10' Neat passing move from Freiburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
8' The goal by Freiburg won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
6' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) finds the back of the net with a superb finish!
4' The Mainz players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
Mainz are awarded the free kick.
Daniel Schlager will supervise the game today.
